title: No web request waits on the ledger lock
assertion: While a second session holds a practice's `ledger:` lock as a reconcile pass does, each of the seven ledger actions a person sends (match a posting, a deposit or a claim by hand, reverse a match, adjust an entry, write a line off, reopen a line) answers `busy` at once (within two seconds), as a status alone with no identifier, and writes no row, audit event or request key (the same key sent again once the lock is free is taken as new); with the lock free the same actions go through and write as before; a second person’s action sent while the first is in flight is refused the same way
noFileReason: The reconciliation routes’ SYNTHETIC LED-06 practice, with a second session holding the lock: no file.
